standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies chi(E) in terms of the Chern class and chi(O_X), the identity chi(omega_X) = - deg(omega_X), and the base Euler characteristic computation.

standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the symmetry dim H^i(E) = dim H^{1-i}(E^vee (+) omega_X) for locally free E.

core_obligations: Invertibility and the degree identity (proof lines 1246-1259): omega_X is a dualizing module by CM-ness and invertible by the Gorenstein property; applying equation-rr to omega_X and combining with lemma-euler gives 2 chi(O_X) = -deg(omega_X), i.e. deg(omega_X) = -2 chi(O_X).
Riemann-Roch for E (proof lines 1259-1267): substituting the degree identity back into equation-rr yields chi(E) = deg(E) - (1/2) rank(E) deg(omega_X) for locally free E of constant rank.
Duality symmetry (proof lines 1268-1273): the dimension symmetry dim H^i(E) = dim H^{1-i}(E^vee (+) omega_X) follows from duality for X as recorded in the rework remark.
proof_roadmap: Fix invertibility of the dualizing sheaf from the Gorenstein property.
Compute deg(omega_X) from the Riemann-Roch relation applied to omega_X itself.
Substitute back to obtain the chi formula for arbitrary locally free sheaves.
Cite duality for the H^i symmetry.
